purpose: Formal placement policy for build execution. Only authorized build nodes may compile CYNIC source.

policy.rule: Build execution (make:check, make:build, make:build-release) is restricted to nodes declared in infra/registries/build.json -> authorized_build_nodes.
policy.on_violation: Block at admission. Return status 'blocked' with blocker 'build_agent_request_node_not_authorized'.
policy.no_exception: No agent role (including human_admin) overrides this policy. Even human_admin cannot build on cortex.
rationale: cynic-host-cortex is the operator workstation. It is a dirty environment (browsers, IDEs, user processes). Building here would compromise reproducibility and security.
cynic-host-proxmox is the hypervisor. Building on the hypervisor compromises host integrity.
local-kernel executes kernel services. Build workloads risk kernel stability.
forgejo is the source SSOT. Builds on the forge risk source integrity.
cynic-lxc-surrealdb is storage primary. Builds risk storage integrity.
Only cynic-builder is provisioned, monitored, and admitted as a build node.

node_authorization.blocker_message: Node '{node_id}' is not an authorized build node. Build execution is restricted to: {authorized_list}

node_not_explicitly_denied.description: Verify request.node_id is not in explicitly_non_authorized
node_not_explicitly_denied.blocker_message: Node '{node_id}' is explicitly denied for build execution. Reason: {reason}
